title: Sindicato de Caminos protest outside Congress opposing road privatization/toll initiative
location: Outside the Congress of the Republic, 9 avenida and 8a calle, zone 1, Guatemala City
organizer: Sindicato de Caminos / union of Directorate General of Roads workers
participants_original: About 400 people from several departments, according to union representative Elda Callejas
threshold_50_evidence: Prensa Libre reports the union representative estimated approximately 400 participants at this gathering.

start_date.summary: The report explicitly dates the demonstration to Wednesday 14 October 2020.

location.summary: The report specifies outside Congress at 9 avenida and 8a calle in zone 1 of the capital.

demands.summary: Union representative says they oppose initiative 5431/road privatization because it would affect workers and the public through toll payments.

participants.summary: Union representative estimates about 400 people from several departments.

threshold_50.summary: The reported approximate count is substantially above 50.

notes: Candidate evidence supports occurrence, date, site, >50 estimate, and a domestic public-policy demand. Episode onset/ownership remains pending because a 13 October article describes another Caminos workers demonstration; that record has not yet been body-checked.
open_questions: Was the 13 October demonstration part of this same episode or distinct?
Did the action continue after 14 October or recur in November?
Can an additional independent source corroborate the estimate and policy demand?

title: Roads Directorate workers demonstrate outside agency over contract/employment status
location: Outside Directorate General of Roads facilities, Guatemala City; traffic blockage reported on 7a avenida between 10 and 11 calle, with disruption also reported near Tecún Umán bridge in zone 13
organizer: Workers of the Directorate General of Roads; union affiliation not specified in this account
participants_original: Workers of the public agency; no count reported
threshold_50_evidence: No attendance estimate in the article; >=50 remains unresolved.

start_date.summary: Report dated 13 October 2020 and says workers demonstrated that day.

location.summary: Outside Directorate General of Roads facilities in Guatemala City; obstruction on 7a avenida between 10 and 11 calle.

demands.summary: Workers sought contract-related matters and improved employment status; state-policy linkage not fully elaborated.

participants.summary: Only that agency workers took part; no count.

threshold_50.summary: No quantitative or clearly sufficient qualitative estimate.

notes: Keep separate from 14 Oct Congress demonstration until sources establish whether they form one continuous episode or distinct actions.
open_questions: Is contract demand tied to state policy beyond their public employer?
Same event/episode as 14 Oct demonstration, or separate?

title: Caminos union demonstrations at zone 13 and the Atlantic Highway on 21 Oct
location: Two separately reported sites: 7a avenida/10 calle, zone 13, Guatemala City; km 7.3 on the Atlantic Highway (separate crowd records).
organizer: Sindicato de Trabajadores Camineros de la República de Guatemala (STC)
threshold_50_evidence: No attendance estimate in source; threshold remains unknown at each site.

location.summary: Reports 7a Ave/10 Calle zone 13 and km 7.3 Atlantic Highway separately.

demands.summary: Opposition to tolls, privatization and bill 5431; asks preservation of Caminos institutionality.

threshold_50.summary: No crowd number for either location.

notes: Strong continuity in organizer and bill with the 13–14 Oct actions, but separate dates/sites and no count here. Do not combine attendance with those events.
open_questions: Do 13,14,21,29 Oct Caminos actions form one episode or separate actions under episode/onset rules?

title: Former soldiers block multiple routes and demonstrate for veterans’ dignity bill on 26 Oct
location: Multiple separate highway points: km 178 Retalhuleu; km 175 Verapaces/San Julián; km 245 Izabal/La Ruidosa; km 70 Patzicía, Chimaltenango; km 117 Interamericana/Las Trampas, Sololá; El Boquerón, Santa Rosa; in front of Congress, Guatemala City; km 146.5 La Fragua, Zacapa.
organizer: Former soldiers; report identifies Avemitregua announcement and an association president but multiple groups claimed representation disputed.
participants_original: No per-site count. The effects included traffic disruption affecting thousands (not protester count).
threshold_50_evidence: No attendee count at any site; cannot infer threshold from road impact or aggregate separate gatherings.

start_date.summary: Report dated 26 Oct states blockades began at 06:00 and lanes reopened after 13:00.

location.summary: Lists multiple specific but separate route points and Congress gathering.

demands.summary: Pressure on government to approve bill 5604 for dignity of soldiers and families, including campaign-pledged compensation.

threshold_50.summary: No count per blockade/gathering; traffic disruption figures describe affected travelers, not demonstrators.

notes: Keep each route blockade distinct for threshold and state response. Agreement/representation dispute and multiple associations require episode-owner review.
open_questions: Did any named single gathering exceed 50?
Which organization controlled each site and are the 26 Oct actions one coordinated episode?
Does evidence show a direct demand to government, separately from campaign pledge references?
protester_violence_note: A clash is reported at km 178 only; article says demonstrators threw stones and police used tear gas there. Do not project this response/violence onto other listed locations.
state_response_note: PNC cleared km 178 blockade by viceminister order; source does not describe state response at every other site.
